main_text.p: peramento tale duellum ap-Azor.In-stit.Mo-ral.part. 3. libr.2. cap.5. probandum videtur, si respu-blica legitimum bellum gerat, si satis virium non habeat, ut hosti potenti resistat, resque sit desperata, nisi tale duellum su-scipiatur, in quo ea respublica superior censebitur, cujus propugnator victoriam reporta-verit. Exemplum hujus illustre occurrit in historiis Go-Johan. Magnus Goth. Hi-stor. libr. 11. thorum Suenonumque. Cum enim Gramus Danorum Rex Scariae Gothorum Regis po-tentiam formidaret, adeo ut eum superari non posse, crederet, à singulari certamine præ-sidium opportunum mutuari constituit; in quo Gothorum rege interfecto rem Sueciae nu-tantem fecit, ac fere despera-tam.
Neque obstat, quod[?] non videatur tantum negotium col-locandum esse in capite unius. Quia non aliter hoc duellum

page.notes: The second paragraph is cut off at the foot of the page; its continuation is on the next page. The reading "quod" in the second paragraph has a doubtful mark over the u, so it is marked [?]. The marginal notes have no reference marks in the text, so each note is placed beside the line where it begins. The catchword "ad-" is the first word of the next page.
